capabilities: generate charts from tables, checkbox lists, JSON, and key:value blocks
pick category and value columns and swap axes for table data
auto-refresh charts when their source data block changes
aggregate checkbox data across the vault or a folder into one chart
export charts as PNG and edit charts as fenced code blocks
extras: The manifest description carries the notice "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff."
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render note data as charts; users must export data elsewhere or hand-write diagram code.

relations.evidence: Any valid Chart.js configuration can be placed in the data and options fields.

summary: Charting plugin that turns Markdown tables, checkbox lists, JSON, and key:value blocks into interactive, auto-refreshing charts inserted into notes.
